description.value: Established in 1988, The Lighthouse Pub is a waterfront pub and restaurant on Wharf Avenue in Sechelt with views of the Sechelt Inlet year-round. It serves a full food menu including seafood dishes and wings, and pours from 18 taps featuring house brews by Foamers' Folly. The scenic wharf-side setting makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast.
